from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="The procedural role, e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Applicant")

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """A legal fee or cost mentioned in the judgment."""
    fee_type: str = Field(description="The type of fee, e.g., Case Acceptance Fee, Appraisal Fee")
    amount: str = Field(description="The fee amount as written in the document")
    bearing_info: str = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g. 'Appellant pays all' or split details")

class JudgmentFact(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or header of the document")
    proceeding_type: str = Field(description="The type of proceeding, e.g., Second Instance, Retrial, Reconsideration")
    disposition: str = Field(description="The core ruling, e.g., Dismiss Appeal & Uphold")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[FeeRecord] = Field(description="List of court fees and cost allocations")
    revoked_case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case numbers explicitly revoked or referenced")
    judgment_type: str = Field(description="Final type, e.g., Judgment, Ruling, Reconsideration")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentFact]
